Name: Simple Skills Extended (Try out SSE 2)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b]✦ Simple Skills Extended ✦[/b][/size]

[size=5][color=#FFE680][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[size=4][size=5][b]📈 Progression & editions[/b][/size]

Choose Level 100 or Level 30; install one SimpleSkillsExtended edition. Native unbuffed skills stay capped at 10: SSE grants separate listed rewards, while food buffs, professions and Mastery keep their roles. Early perks follow ordinary unbuffed levels. Extended progression unlocks when all five native skills reach 10; Mastery 5/cave rewards are not required. Overflow is banked until eligible.

Level 11 costs 1,500 overflow XP, with each following level costing 350 more than the previous. Level 100 can recognize recorded native overflow; Level 30 tracks new overflow after installation while retaining mod progression. Edition switching preserves stored progression/professions; Level 30 applies only its supported range and has its own reward curve. High-level whole extra yields are guaranteed, with fractional remainders rolled.

[size=5][b]🌱 Rewards[/b][/size]

Farming: matching crops, fertilizer refunds/retention, newly planted crop growth and quality. Fishing: bite waits, tackle protection, catch-progress protection, fishing-bar size and extra rod catches. Foraging: wood, hardwood, seeds, matching/seasonal forage. Mining: stone, ore, own-bomb protection and eligible ladder chances. Combat: ordinary loot rolls, health, melee speed, cooldowns and eligible melee-kill healing.

Level 100 also adds seed/animal-product bonuses, expanded fish quality/treasure, forage quality, gems/geodes/shaft/ore-vein benefits, direct weapon damage and death prevention from Combat 50 with its own cooldown. Rewards accumulate as listed in the journal; bonus drops do not recursively reward themselves. Quality respects supported caps and existing crops retain their schedules.

[size=5][b]📖 Journal, controls & professions[/b][/size]

Open Skills and select a vanilla skill/level number; controller A selects. My Level returns to current progress. Settings offers Simplify/Detailed and per-farmer effect controls; load the farmer’s save first. The optional keyboard/controller journal binding starts Off.

Additional unowned professions are chosen after sleep at levels 15, 20, 25 and 30 while retaining earlier choices. Already owning all professions avoids empty pickers. Reward windows start On in optional GMCM; disabling them retains rewards/profession choices. Old levels and prestige-recovered levels do not replay earned windows. Custom skills keep their own windows.

Control Mariner, Agriculturist, SSE quality/growth; Level 100 adds vein mining, animal multiplication and death prevention switches. Disabling effects preserves earned progress/professions/Fully Mastered. Styled bars/nameplates start On.

[size=5][b]🤝 Integrations & important limits[/b][/size]

Optional World Tiers supplies farm tiers separately from SSE personal rewards. Resource bonuses add to original drops instead of multiplying bonus drops; native/SSE growth precedes SWT reduction. Disabling SSE effects does not disable SWT effects. Simple Experience Bar reads extended XP; SpaceCore skills retain their own progression/caps. Separate Simple Skill Bars stands aside while SSE loads.

Focused integration checks referenced SSE 1.18 with Mastery Extended 2.3.1, Walk of Life 1.5.0-Beta5, Vanilla Plus Professions 1.1.1, Apex Mastery 3.6.6 and Skill Prestige 1.4.4-unofficial.5. These are version-specific checks, not certification of newer versions or complete combinations. [b]Walk of Life conflicts with Vanilla Plus Professions; Mastery Extended lists Skill Prestige as incompatible.[/b]

Love of Cooking 2.0.8/SpaceCore Luck 1.7.0 retain separate progression. Skill Prestige requires optional SpaceCore Adapters 1.0.1; Cooking surplus needs Painless mode/registered prestige and does not create levels above 10. Complete adapter registration remains unverified. Original Experience Bars’ SSE display is unverified. Live multiplayer, split-screen, Android and wider combinations are not certified.

[size=5][b]📦 Requirements, migration & languages[/b][/size]

Desktop Stardew Valley 1.6.15+, SMAPI 4.4.0+, all 12 game languages. Extract one SimpleSkillsExtended edition into Mods. Multiplayer participants should match version/edition. GMCM, SWT, SEB and SpaceCore are optional for their integrations.

Remove predecessor SimpleMasteryExpansion: keeping it loaded disables SSE gameplay hooks. Supported XP, professions, pending choices, effects and crop/animal/cooldown records migrate without manual save edits. Update optional SWT/SEB to compatible releases. For reports, include edition, relevant skill level and other progression mods.

[size=5][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/size]

Share bugs or suggestions on this mod’s page. For bugs, include your mod/game/SMAPI versions, platform, expected versus actual behaviour, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot if useful. For suggestions, explain the change and how it would help.[/size]
